# iMBrace in action

Ingram Micro Singapore's partner site: 20 business use cases running on iMBrace, with live chats, recorded runs and how each one was built.

**Live site:** https://ingram-micro-asia-singapore.github.io/imbrace-in-action/

## How this repository works

The pages here are generated. Don't edit them by hand: a change made here is overwritten at the next publish. The site is built from Ingram Micro Singapore's study repository, checked, and published here after review. The steps are in that repository's `docs/ONBOARDING.md`, under "Rebuild and republish the partner site".

The only files kept by hand are in `.github/`:

- `site-contacts.html`: the contacts shown on the site;
- `live-channels.json`: the chat channels the live-chat cases use.

The companies and data in the demos are fictional.
